svg.title: How a judgement travels between the CLI and a skill
svg.desc: gnd discover reads the model and the population and writes evidence that holds counts, digests, opaque row ids and candidate readings, never a value. A skill reads the model and the evidence only, never the population, decides each group by its rules and asks you where the rules stop, then writes a judgements file bound to the evidence by SHA-256. gnd discover reads the judgements back, computes the evidence again, refuses on any difference, checks every verdict and renders an additive proposal. gnd evolve preview with the additive policy checks it; gnd evolve apply is your reviewed step.
svg.text: One judgement round
GND counts
gnd discover ... --families fact-type --type-evidence evidence.json
reads the model and the population; groups rows by attribute
writes evidence: counts, digests, opaque row ids, candidate readings · no value
A skill judges
/gnd:gnd-judge-fact-types · /gnd:gnd-model-multivalued
reads the model and the evidence · never the population
decides each group by its rules, R1–R4 or S1–S4, in order
asks you where the rules stop; writes nothing until every group has a verdict
writes the judgements file, bound to the evidence by its SHA-256
GND checks and renders
gnd discover ... --type-evidence-in EVIDENCE --duplicate-judgements FILE
computes the evidence again; refuses (3) when a byte differs
checks every verdict against the evidence and the model's origins
renders: distinct proposed · many-to-many proposed, uniqueness over both roles
duplicate listed as a judged shape match · skip counted
GND previews the round
gnd evolve preview MODEL proposal.json --policy additive
admitted: breaking false; every constraint induced, proposed, deontic
You apply, after review
gnd evolve apply ... --policy additive · named on the page, not run
